import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    s = list(map(int, input[n+1:2*n+1]))

    pos_p = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        pos_p[p[i]] = i

    operations = []
    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] != s[i]:
            target = s[i]
            current = p[i]
            target_pos = pos_p[target]

            operations.append((i + 1, target_pos + 1))
            p[i], p[target_pos] = p[target_pos], p[i]
            pos_p[current], pos_p[target] = pos_p[target], pos_p[current]

    min_coins = sum(abs(i - j) for i, j in operations)
    k = len(operations)

    print(min_coins)
    print(k)
    for op in operations:
        print(op[0], op[1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
